target_description_html:
This same-concept compact successor preserves the reader-first SGA surface from version 10.5281/zenodo.21631125. Seventy-three predecessor files outside the three release controls are retained byte-identically; the controls are refreshed and two bounded SGA6 source-audit visual-evidence archives are added.

The targeted archive contains two tight formula, glyph, prose, locator, and diagram-junction crops actually opened during the SGA6 cold source re-verification. They map parent indices 627-631 to the stable five-entry audit boundary #1379-#1383, spanning the close of Expose XII and the opening of Expose XIII through Proposition 1.4 and its diagram chase; the continuation cursor is idx632. Every crop records parent identity, source page, pixel bounding box, dimensions, scaling, generator identity, linked audit entry, target context, and QA disposition.

The paired provenance archive records 25 routine full-width page bands as rights_blocked_not_public. Their hashes, coordinates, dimensions, DPI, generator identities, and target links are public, while their pixels are withheld. No generated-but-unread tight alternative exists in this tranche.

The parent is the 720-page reader Theorie des intersections et theoreme de Riemann-Roch, 26,833,956 bytes, SHA-256 73FBBAD41340C12ECCDCFCF6C3A1656953FE3D712AA8E391678458CCD17B4BAA. The parent PDF and routine page-band pixels are not redistributed.

These crops are visual and provenance evidence, not certification of the French transcription, English translation, mathematics, completeness, or critical-edition status. Rights in the underlying French work and scan remain with their holders; no blanket license or rights transfer is asserted. Across the current same-concept crop series, 2,196 selected images are public and 3,323 routine page derivatives are represented by rights-blocked metadata. Machine-assisted contributors include OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT and Anthropic Claude under human direction.

The SGA reader surface is otherwise unchanged. In particular, the current public SGA3 surface remains a cumulative working reader through Expose IV plus standalone complete working readers for Exposes V, VI, VIII, IX, and XI. Expose VII remains held because footnote 41 overlaps DIAG033 inside footnote 40 on physical page 26 / printed page 22; Exposes X and XII-XXVI remain absent. This successor updates only existing SGA concept 10.5281/zenodo.20410947.
target_notes_html:
Reader-first compact surface. Direct working readers and primary editable TeX remain individually accessible; recursive sources, machine ledgers, QA, predecessor checkpoints, and visual evidence are grouped into ZIP archives. SGA1 remains the default preview.

Exact public shape: 78 outer files, including 48 ZIP archives. Literal ZIP replay contains 3,870 non-directory members plus 7 directory entries (3,877 total ZIP records) and 405,444,895 uncompressed bytes. The release-control compatibility counter is 3,876. Seventy-three non-control files from predecessor record 21631125 are retained byte-for-byte.

SGA6 visual-evidence addition: 2 targeted high-detail crops actually opened during the idx627-631 cold source audit, covering audit entries #1379-#1383 with continuation idx632. The paired metadata archive records 25 routine page bands as rights-blocked and records 0 generated-but-unread tight alternatives. Cumulative same-concept controls now account for 2,196 selected public source-audit images and 3,323 rights-blocked routine page derivatives.

SGA3 Expose VII hold: no VII reader or repair package is release-ready. The controlling blocker is the physical-page-26 / printed-page-22 collision where footnote 41 overlaps DIAG033 inside footnote 40. Publication requires a no-overwrite layout repair, a full 300/600/900-1200 dpi cold replay, a fresh source freeze, a rebuilt reference graph/package, and an independent release PASS.
